--- files: kekkai_meta.js kekkai_runtime.js module.wasm worker.js wrangler.toml
--- worker.js
// Generated by kek. Capabilities are created here from Worker bindings;
// this is the only place where the program receives authority.
//
// Configuration (wrangler.toml):
//   [[d1_databases]] DB            D1 database for a `db: &Db` parameter (default backend)
//   [[durable_objects.bindings]] KEKKAI_DO (class KekkaiObject)
//                                  route every request into a Durable Object and
//                                  keep Db data in its transactional storage
//   KEKKAI_DO_SHARD = "global" | "segment:N" | "header:NAME" | "query:NAME"
//                                  which object a request goes to (default "global")
//   KEKKAI_OUTBOX = "fetch" | "log" | "queue"
//                                  how outbox entries are delivered after commit
//                                  (default "fetch"; "queue" needs a producer bound as OUTBOX)
import wasm from "./module.wasm";
import meta from "./kekkai_meta.js";
import {
  createKekkai, dbCap, D1KvStore, DurableObjectStore, consoleLog, fetchNet, systemClock, cryptoRandom,
  fetchOutbox, logOutbox, queueOutbox,
} from "./kekkai_runtime.js";

const app = createKekkai(wasm, meta);

function outbox(env) {
  const mode = env.KEKKAI_OUTBOX || (env.OUTBOX ? "queue" : "fetch");
  switch (mode) {
    case "fetch": return fetchOutbox();
    case "log": return logOutbox();
    case "queue":
      if (!env.OUTBOX) throw new Error("KEKKAI_OUTBOX=queue needs a Queue producer binding named OUTBOX");
      return queueOutbox(env.OUTBOX);
    default: throw new Error("unknown KEKKAI_OUTBOX mode " + mode);
  }
}

// db(binding) returns the store backing the Db capability of that binding.
function capabilities(env, db) {
  return {
    "db": dbCap(db("DB"), outbox(env)),
    "log": consoleLog(),
  };
}

const d1Stores = new WeakMap();
function d1Store(env, binding) {
  const d1 = env[binding];
  if (!d1) throw new Error("missing D1 binding " + binding + " (or bind a Durable Object namespace as KEKKAI_DO)");
  let s = d1Stores.get(d1);
  if (!s) d1Stores.set(d1, (s = new D1KvStore(d1)));
  return s;
}

// The name of the Durable Object a request is routed to. Transactions are
// atomic within one object, so the shard key must cover every key a
// transaction touches (e.g. a tenant or account id in the path).
function shardName(request, env) {
  const spec = env.KEKKAI_DO_SHARD || "global";
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const [kind, arg] = spec.split(/:(.*)/s);
  let v = null;
  if (kind === "global") v = "global";
  else if (kind === "segment") v = url.pathname.split("/").filter((s) => s !== "")[Number(arg)] ?? null;
  else if (kind === "header") v = request.headers.get(arg);
  else if (kind === "query") v = url.searchParams.get(arg);
  else throw new Error("unknown KEKKAI_DO_SHARD " + spec);
  return v === null || v === "" ? null : kind + ":" + v;
}

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    if (env.KEKKAI_DO) {
      const name = shardName(request, env);
      if (name === null) return new Response("missing shard key", { status: 400 });
      return env.KEKKAI_DO.get(env.KEKKAI_DO.idFromName(name)).fetch(request);
    }
    return app.handle(request, capabilities(env, (b) => d1Store(env, b)), ctx);
  },

  // Outbox consumer for KEKKAI_OUTBOX = "queue": at-least-once delivery.
  async queue(batch, env) {
    for (const msg of batch.messages) {
      try {
        const r = await fetch(msg.body.url, { method: "POST", body: msg.body.body });
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error("status " + r.status);
        msg.ack();
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("kekkai: outbox delivery failed, will retry:", e);
        msg.retry();
      }
    }
  },
};

// Durable Object running the program next to its storage. Each Db binding
// gets its own key prefix inside the object.
export class KekkaiObject {
  constructor(state, env) {
    this.state = state;
    this.env = env;
    this.stores = new Map();
  }
  store(binding) {
    let s = this.stores.get(binding);
    if (!s) this.stores.set(binding, (s = new DurableObjectStore(this.state.storage, { prefix: binding + ":" })));
    return s;
  }
  async fetch(request) {
    return app.handle(request, capabilities(this.env, (b) => this.store(b)), {});
  }
}
